name: BNM Risk Management in Technology (RMiT)
nature: Binding policy document. 'S' paragraphs are standards; 'G' paragraphs are guidance.
reference_note: Paragraph numbers were read from the September 2026 revision. Confirm against your institution's copy before citing them to a supervisor.

controls.expectation: Conduct rigorous system testing prior to deployment.
Testing scope should include regression, exception and negative testing.

controls.topic: Independent review and approval of changes
controls.expectation: System changes are independently reviewed and approved.
Third-party developers give sufficient notice before changes to critical systems.
controls.note: ModelAssure records and verifies which vendor build was tested. The contractual notice requirement is outside its scope.

controls.expectation: The institution remains accountable for managing all risks from third-party service providers.
controls.note: Provides independent behavioural evidence on a vendor's release; broader third-party due diligence (S 10.47) is separate.

controls.expectation: User activities in critical systems are logged for audit and investigations; activity logs are kept for at least three years.
controls.note: Audit events are append-only and never purged by ModelAssure's evidence retention task. Keep the database backups for at least three years.
